svg.text: Sensor Module (A and B) — ESP32 DevKitC 38-pin — full wiring
Same wiring on both modules. Coloured labels 5V / 3.3V / GND = the breadboard power rails. No pull-up resistors needed.
Pin 1 = leftmost ribbon pin when the keys face you.
Pin 8 → GPIO 4 on the other side (purple label).
Power rails: ESP32 5V pin → top + rail (5V) · ESP32 3V3 pin → bottom + rail (3.3V) · both GND pins → the − rails (join the two − rails). Every label with the same name is the same rail.
No pull-up resistors: the PIRs (17, 19) and the tamper switch (23) use the ESP32’s built-in pull-up. An unplugged PIR still reads as "stuck" and a cut tamper wire still reads as "open".
Yellow LED on pin 2 and red LED on pin 15 are boot pins: an LED + resistor to GND is safe there (the red one may blink once at power-on). Never add a pull-up resistor to 2 or 15.
LEDs: 220–330 Ω each (2.2 kΩ works, dimmer); long leg = anode, towards the ESP32. Grey pins are not used (VP = spare for an IR sensor later).
Wire by the labels printed on YOUR board — some clones put the pins in a different order.
